questions.question: What happens when the bride hesitates to open to her beloved in chapter 5?
options: He is gone when she opens, and she searches for him
He leaves her forever and never once returns again
He waits very patiently outside the door until dawn
He falls fast asleep at the door until the morning
questions.answer: He is gone when she opens, and she searches for him

questions.question: What does the bride do in chapter 5 when asked about her beloved?
options: Forgets all about him and turns her thoughts entirely away
Describes his beauty in detail to the daughters of Jerusalem
Mocks him openly before all of the daughters of the city
Ignores the women around her and says nothing at all to them
questions.answer: Describes his beauty in detail to the daughters of Jerusalem

questions.question: In chapter 5 the bride calls her beloved 'altogether lovely.'
I opened to my beloved, but my beloved had turned and _____.
My beloved is radiant and _____, distinguished among ten thousand.
